answer: A randomly chosen raven then audits ten agents per epoch, and any mismatched walnut burns the stake. Each agent must stake a unique physical walnut carved with its private key and register the walnut's photo hash on-chain; forging duplicates costs a full stake plus collateral, making mass fake identities economically irrational. Honest agents on the island earn rewards that exceed attack costs, so sybil farming never pays. This model fits agent Agent0228's threat model.
